claim_boundary: This stage is a trainer/tokenizer experiment contract only.
It does not authorize tokenizer replacement in the selected 100M frontier.
It does not authorize training or promotion.
Recent paper claims were checked against arXiv pages, but this artifact does not reproduce their experiments.

current_target.embedding_structure: enc_embed and dec_embed are separate; lm_head is tied to enc_embed.weight

hard_rules: Do not replace the hashlocked 1506 tokenizer in target_100m frontier or protected-gate runs.
Tokenizer/vocab/overencoding experiments must run in a separate diagnostic lane with no promotion claims.
Compare tokenizers by raw UTF-8 bytes, BPB where decoder CE is meaningful, downstream bounded-maintainer scores, latency, and effective byte context, not token perplexity alone.
Hold raw train bytes, byte-level context coverage, optimizer, data order, and wallclock/FLOP budget fixed across tokenizer comparisons.
For current bounded-choice maintainer heads, tokenizer changes are secondary to row semantics; do not use tokenizer work to bypass Stage12151 blockers.

near_term_advice_for_current_blockers: Do not spend GPU training tokenizer variants until Stage12149 corrected selected-test rows exist and Stage12150 passes. Tokenizer diagnostics can run CPU/read-only now, but model training should wait for correct maintainer supervision.

parameter_costs_agentkernel_seq2seq.formula: delta_params = 2 * (new_vocab - 1506) * 640 because encoder and decoder embeddings both grow; lm_head is tied to encoder embedding
parameter_costs_agentkernel_seq2seq.note: This is nontrivial but acceptable as a diagnostic branch for a 102.65M target; it is not a drop-in compatible runtime with existing checkpoints.

purpose: Formalize recent tokenizer/compression advice for the agentkernel_lite_encdec_v1 seq2seq trainer without destabilizing the current selected-test maintainer frontier.

recommended_experiment_order.description: Measure compression, dead-token fraction, label tokenization, and effective context bytes for current manifests.
recommended_experiment_order.name: tokenizer_metrics_only_current_1506

recommended_experiment_order.description: Keep 1506-way output and hashlocked decoder vocabulary; add encoder-only byte-token bigram/trigram hashed features or learned ngram embeddings. This is the lowest-risk new idea because it avoids an 8K softmax.
recommended_experiment_order.name: fixed_output_input_overencoding_probe

recommended_experiment_order.description: Train a from-scratch diagnostic 1506-vocab tokenizer alternative on the same corpus to test BPE objective vs vocabulary size.
recommended_experiment_order.name: same_vocab_mingram_or_unigram_static_probe

recommended_experiment_order.description: If current bytes/token is too low, train a 4096 byte-BPE tokenizer and compare at fixed raw bytes and compute.
recommended_experiment_order.name: bpe_4096_static_probe

recommended_experiment_order.description: Only after basic metrics, test two-phase subword-first/superword-second tokenization at 4096. Useful mainly if prompt text has repeated phrases and long structured fields.
recommended_experiment_order.name: superword_or_boundless_4096_probe

recommended_experiment_order.description: Run only if 4096 improves BPB/downstream enough to justify +8.56M embedding params in this seq2seq model.
recommended_experiment_order.name: bpe_8192_probe

recommended_experiment_order.description: Requires architecture rewrite; not appropriate until static tokenizer and input-overencoding lanes are exhausted.
recommended_experiment_order.name: hnet_blt_style_architecture

required_measurements_before_training: single_token_rate_for bounded labels/options such as A/B/C or opaque X8 labels
UTF8_generation_validity for any decoder/generation audit branch

trainer_surface_recommendations.gating: Any tokenizer experiment must emit the artifacts above and must be evaluated against unchanged Stage11924/Stage12099/Stage11507 protected gates before any claim.
